statement: Pinned OpenPuck emulates device-info and SPI responses for stick/IMU calibration, exposes an emulated user-calibration mirror, and synthesizes acknowledgements for host subcommands including input mode, pairing, and SPI read/write.

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: OpenPuck has authored factory bytes and emulator-persistence policy; these are not a verified retail EEPROM/SPI dump or proof of matching physical write semantics.
